name: Guru
description: Guru's hosted server searches verified knowledge cards and collections, so answers come from what your team maintains.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.api.getguru.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
